name: Skill Check with Token Usage Dashboard

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Daily at 2 AM UTC

jobs:
  validate-skill:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build project
        run: dotnet build --no-restore

      - name: Run skill validation
        run: |
          dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator/SkillValidator.csproj
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Collect token metrics
        run: |
          powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1
        if: always()

      - name: Generate benchmark data with tokens
        run: |
          powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/generate-benchmark-data.ps1
        if: always()

      - name: Upload token usage data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: data/token-usage.json
        if: always()

      - name: Upload benchmark data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: data/benchmark-results.json
        if: always()

  generate-dashboard:
    needs: validate-skill
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download token usage data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: data/

      - name: Download benchmark data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: data/

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18.x'

      - name: Install Chart.js
        run: npm install chart.js

      - name: Generate dashboard HTML
        run: |
          mkdir -p public/dashboard
          cp dashboard.html public/dashboard/index.html
          cp dashboard.js public/dashboard/
          cp token-usage.js public/dashboard/
          cp -r assets/* public/dashboard/ || true

      - name: Deploy dashboard
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./public
          publish_branch: gh-pages
          keep_files: false
          force_orphan: true

  update-dashboard:
    needs: generate-dashboard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Update dashboard with latest data
        run: |
          powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/update-dashboard.ps1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update dashboard with latest token usage data" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin gh-pages || echo "No changes pushed"

        if: always()

      - name: Upload benchmark data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: data/benchmark-results.json
        if: always()

  generate-dashboard:
    needs: validate-skill
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download token usage data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: data/

      - name: Download benchmark data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: data/

      - name: Setup Node.js

          node-version: '18.x'
